title: Rezoning to allow housing at 1160 Pugsley Avenue, Bronx
summary: This land use application would change the zoning map for a site on Pugsley Avenue in the Bronx from an R5 district to an R7A district with a C2-4 commercial overlay. The rezoning would allow an eight-story mixed-use building with ground-floor commercial space, including a grocery store, and 32 accessory parking spaces. It is linked to a related zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the same site.
